title: Ultrasound — Minimum Requirements
notes: Section opens with a cross-reference: 'Other requirements are as stated under "Minimum requirements for all types of Health Institutions"' (page 33) — see the common all-institutions module; not repeated as items here.

items.requirement: Ultrasound room shall be not less than 10 meters square space providing that at least one examining bed is available.

measurement.expected: not less than 10 meters square as stated

items.quantity: at least one examining bed available

items.requirement: Patient toilet shall be accessible within the ultrasound room with nursing call system.
Lighting: fluorescent lights will provide illumination level up to 540 Candela during patient transfer on and from the table, equipment setting, room cleaning, and equipment maintenance.
